text:
Carla M.: heads-up — product is asking for finer per-request billing/grouping. proposal: a simple header `X-RW-COST-TAGS` carrying semicolon-delimited k=v pairs so customers can tag requests (team=search;flow=semantic). thoughts on sdk impact / telemetry parsing? :thinking:

Dmitri K.: curious about proxies and header size. if users put big JSON in headers some infra strips them. also cardinality concerns for metrics. can we limit keys/values?

Ben S.: runtime note: high-cardinality tags will kill our aggregation if we emit them directly. we need a sampling/rollup plan. also caching layer needs canonicalization (order-insensitive).

Alice W.: from SDK POV we already have optional `metadata` arg in TS/Go. easiest path is to map either header or body field into that struct. question: do we want structured metadata (JSON) or stick to simple k=v string?

Eva L.: docs/console: customers will expect to filter by these tags in the dashboard. if we accept free-form k=v we'll need UI constraints (deny regex, max length) and a migration guide. also we should show token-cost and latency per-tag bucket.

Sam P.: product: priority is low-friction for customers. header approach is simplest for quick adoption (curl/clients). but we can't compromise observability/safety. propose a spec that supports both a compact header and a richer json-encoded field.

Carla M.: concrete example i sketched:  ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \n  -H \"X-RW-COST-TAGS: team=search;flow=semantic;ticket=ENG-789\" \n  -d '{\"input\":\"...\"}'```

Dmitri K.: alternate: `X-RW-META: eyJ0ZWFtIjoic2VhcmNoIiwiZmxvdyI6InNlbWFudGljIn0=` (base64 JSON). smaller header count, richer schema, easier to evolve. but less human-friendly.

Ben S.: agree base64-json solves ordering and parsing. but then we must ensure proxies/GW don't reject base64 either. also keep a max decoded size, e.g. 2KB.

Alice W.: SDK plan: add `meta` param to all clients (py/ts/go). implementation: if `meta` provided and env `RW_SDK_META_SHIM=true` then also emit legacy `X-RW-COST-TAGS` as fallback for 90 days. document deprecation window.

sdk-bot: API spec PR filed: https://git.internal/redwood/api-spec/pull/1224 — includes `x-rw-meta` base64-json + legacy `x-rw-cost-tags` shim. automated tests included.

Eva L.: UX asks: console should accept both formats and normalize. add backend job to parse incoming tags and bucket by controlled key whitelist (team, flow, ticket) to avoid cardinality blow-up. add sampling if unseen tag values > 1000/day.

Ben S.: telemetry change: do NOT attach raw tags to all traces. only sample 1% with full tags and emit aggregated counts for all. add a telemetry flag `tagging-full-sample-rate` per org.

Sam P.: rollout: feature-flag `meta-header-v2` per account, enable for early customers, then SDK shim for everyone for 90 days, then flip default in SDKs after 90 days. legal/security to sign off on free-text tag acceptance?

Carla M.: action items i captured: 1) eng-platform: finalize header name + size limits (dmitri/ben) 2) sdks: implement `meta` param + shim env (alice) 3) console: parsing + UI constraints (eva) 4) product/legal: policy on accepted tag keys (sam) 5) infra: ensure gw/proxies pass base64 headers (dmitri) deadline: 2 weeks.

Dmitri K.: noted — i'll run a quick proxy pass test this afternoon and post results.

Alice W.: i'll open sdk PRs (py/ts/go) and include compatibility tests. plan to add a smoke CI job that toggles `RW_SDK_META_SHIM`.

Eva L.: i'll prototype console filter UI with placeholder buckets. expecting some backend work to normalize tags.

Ben S.: i'll draft telemetry sampling defaults and add aggregation pipeline caps.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: api-spec PR -> staging on 3495001270 :rocket:

Carla M.: thanks all. good meeting-of-the-minds. we'll sync again after the proxy run + initial SDK PRs. :+1:
